  have hpl := Real.pi_gt_d2
  have hpu := Real.pi_lt_d4
  have hel := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have heu := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have he : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hy2 : (2.3 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ he]; linarith
  have hy3 : 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 < (2.32 : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ he]; linarith
  generalize 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 = y at *
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith

    rw [Real.lt_logb_iff_rpow_lt (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast]
    have e6 : (2 : ℝ) ^ 6 = 64 := by norm_num

  have l50 : Real.logb 2 (y ^ 50) < ((61 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by

parsed.claim: A coarse numeric sanity check of the manuscript constant: 0.6 < (1/2)·logb 2 (2π/e) < 0.61. This is consistent with the stated 0.6044… and shows the 30-digit interval is at least in the right place. It does not verify the 30 digits.

theorem probe_alpha_coarse :
    (0.6 : ℝ) < (1/2 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1) ∧
    (1/2 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1) < 0.61 := by
  have hpl := Real.pi_gt_d2
  have hpu := Real.pi_lt_d4
  have hel := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have heu := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have he : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hy2 : (2.3 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ he]; linarith
  have hy3 : 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 < (2.32 : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ he]; linarith
  generalize 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 = y at *
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
  have h5 : (64 : ℝ) < y ^ 5 := by
    calc (64 : ℝ) < (2.3 : ℝ) ^ 5 := by norm_num
      _ < y ^ 5 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hy2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h50 : y ^ 50 < (2 : ℝ) ^ 61 := by
    calc y ^ 50 < (2.32 : ℝ) ^ 50 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hy3 hy0.le (by norm_num)
      _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ 61 := by norm_num
  have l5 : ((6 : ℕ) : ℝ) < Real.logb 2 (y ^ 5) := by
    rw [Real.lt_logb_iff_rpow_lt (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast]
    have e6 : (2 : ℝ) ^ 6 = 64 := by norm_num
    rw [e6]; exact h5
  have l50 : Real.logb 2 (y ^ 50) < ((61 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast]
    exact h50
  have a5 := Real.logb_pow 2 5 y
  have a50 := Real.logb_pow 2 50 y
  push_cast at a5 a50 l5 l50
  constructor <;> linarith
